verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: The two functions do different jobs. _diffStyle computes the SGR code delta between two cells, and _isAttributeDefault is a predicate that checks whether one cell has default attributes. _diffStyle already calls _isAttributeDefault, so it reuses the predicate instead of reimplementing it. Both read the same cell flags (bold, italic and so on), but that is only shared inputs. There is no common operation that could move into a helper. A flag-enumeration helper would be generic syntax with no contract the two functions share.
